nri-world.title: Who Is Ashoke Sen? The Kolkata Physicist Who Unified String Theory — and Just Became the First Indian to Win the Oskar Klein Medal
nri-world.excerpt: He did his apprenticeship at Fermilab and Stanford, then chose in 1988 to build his career in India. Four decades later, Ashoke Sen — Breakthrough Prize laureate, Dirac medallist, Fellow of the Royal Society at 42 — has received Stockholm's Oskar Klein Medal, an honour no Indian physicist had won in its 38 years.

food.title: Dry-Roasted Poha Chivda: A Low-Oil Diwali Snack That Stays Crisp for Weeks
food.excerpt: Thin poha dry-roasted until crisp, then tossed with nuts and a mustard-seed tempering in just 3 tablespoons of oil — a complete sourced recipe for festive snacking without deep frying.
food.nri_angle: A make-ahead, shippable Diwali savoury for diaspora kitchens: one batch covers guests, gift jars and the tea tin, and keeps crisp for up to two weeks airtight.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

steps: Add thin poha in a wide pan. Dry roast on low flame till it is crisp. Keep it aside.
In the same pan heat oil. Add peanuts and roast till crisp.
Add cashew, roasted gram dal, dry coconut slices and roast for 3-4 minutes.
Then add raisin and roast till the raisins puff up. Keep the nuts aside.
In the same pan add mustard seeds and let it crackle.
Add green chili, curry leaves and saute till crisp and dry. Then add hing, turmeric, red chili powder, roasted nuts and mix well.
Now add nuts mixture to roasted poha along with salt, powdered sugar, aamchur powder and mix everything well.
Cool completely before storing; store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks.

carousel.title: Jailer 2 Rises to Rs 443 Crore in India After Record Second Weekend
carousel.excerpt: Pinkvilla puts the Rajinikanth sequel at Rs. 443.25 crore India gross after 12 days and about Rs. 690 crore worldwide — already Kollywood's biggest film globally, with the India record in reach.
carousel.nri_angle: A Tamil blockbuster passing Rs. 690 crore worldwide shows how much of Kollywood's top end is now earned from diaspora screens overseas.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Have Bulletproof Workload Plan for New Zealand Tour, Morkel Says
carousel.excerpt: With the first Test starting four days after the ODI series ends, India will keep a cover group of bowlers in New Zealand — and Arshdeep Singh is in the conversation for a Test debut.
carousel.nri_angle: India's New Zealand tour is a major live-cricket draw for the large Indian diaspora in New Zealand and for US and UK fans following the series across time zones.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: IIT Madras Scientist Helps Show a Spinning Molecule Can Boost Current 100-Fold
carousel.excerpt: A helicene molecule trapped between gold electrodes rotates when voltage is applied — and its rotation opens high-conductance shapes that raise current up to 100 times, in a Nature study co-authored by IIT Madras's Anil Kumar Singh.
carousel.nri_angle: The study puts an IIT Madras physicist in a five-country Nature paper on molecular machines, a field Indian researchers and students abroad work in directly.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: CPI(M) and Unions Challenge IDBI Sale to Fairfax as Staff Set November Strike
carousel.excerpt: The ₹52,878-crore sale of 60.72% to Canada's Fairfax would be the largest foreign investment in an Indian bank; the government says employee terms and pensions are contractually protected.
carousel.nri_angle: Fairfax is led by Indian-origin Canadian billionaire Prem Watsa; NRI depositors with IDBI accounts face possible branch disruption on November 2-3.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
